verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ADK provides workflow orchestration and deployment to Cloud Run or Agent Runtime. These are developer building blocks and host-platform hosting for agents that are 'accessed, queried, and used'. Nothing documents a product-level way to set up automations that run autonomously in the background: no schedules, triggers, recurring or background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
